escenas.texto: Which was the most liked video in Africa this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, The fight between the two couples., by Calm man, with over 203 thousand likes.
In second place, Hindu Bahu in a Muslim Family - Part 1, by Saqib Saifi, with over 254 thousand likes.
And number one: bros hair is a whip, by Greg Batocabe, with over 281 thousand likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
